title: Group by: split-apply-combine - pandas documentation
snippet: groupby() follows the split-apply-combine pattern: split data into groups by a key, apply a function independently to each group, then combine the results.

title: Comprehensive Guide to Grouping and Aggregating with Pandas - Practical Business Python
snippet: The .agg() method lets you apply multiple aggregation functions at once (e.g. sum, mean, count) and is not limited to pandas' built-in functions.
